content: Elimɛlɛkin yɛnun nɔni swɑ̃ɑru
Kpɑrobun wɑɑti sɔɔ, ɡɔ̃ɔrɑ duɑ Isirelibɑn temɔ. Yerɑ durɔ ɡoo u seewɑ Bɛtelehɛmun di ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ Yudɑn temɔ, u dɑ u wɑ̃ɑ Mɔɑbuɔ kɑ win kurɔ kɑ win bii tɔn durɔbu yiru.

Durɔ win yĩsirɑ Elimɛlɛki. Win kurɔwɑ Nɑomi. Win bii ben yĩsɑ wee, Mɑloni kɑ Kilioni. Be kpuro bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ Efɑrɑtɑn bweseru. Ben wuuwɑ Bɛtelehɛmu, Yudɑn temɔ. Ye Elimɛlɛki kɑ win tɔn be kpuro bɑ turɑ Mɔɑbu mi, yerɑ bɑ ben wɑ̃ɑ yeru kuɑ.
Sɔ̃ɔ teeru, Elimɛlɛki u kpunɑ u ɡu. Mɑ u Nɑomi kɑ bibu yiru ye deri.
Mɑ bii be, bɑ Mɔɑbun bii wɔndiɑbɑ suɑ kurɔbu. Kurɔ ben turon yĩsirɑ Oripɑ, turowɑ mɑɑ Rutu. Mɑ bɑ wɑ̃ɑ mi sɑnnu sere n kɑ kuɑ wɔ̃ɔ wɔkuru.
Yen biruwɑ Mɑloni kɑ Kilioni bɑ kpunɑ bɑ ɡu. Mɑ Nɑomi u tiɑ wi turo. U ǹ kɑ win durɔ, u ǹ mɑɑ kɑ win bibu yiru ye.
Nɑomi kɑ Rutu
bɑ ɡɔsirɑ Bɛtelehɛmuɔ
Yenibɑn biru, Nɑomi u nuɑ Gusunɔ u win tɔmbu durom kuɑ u bu dĩɑnu wɛ̃. Yerɑ u seewɑ sɔ̃ɔ teeru kɑ win biɡii kurɔbu Mɔɑbun di, bɑ wiɔ Yudɑn temɔ.
Mɑ u biɡii kurɔ be sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bɛɛn bɑɑwure u wuro win mɛron yɛnuɔ, kpɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u bɛɛ ɡeɑ kuɑ nɡe mɛ i bɛɛn durɔ be bɑ ɡu kuɑ, kɑ mɑɑ nɛn tii.
Kpɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u de bɛɛn bɑɑwure u durɔ wɑ u wɛ̃rɑ win yɛnuɔ. Mɑ u ben bɑɑwure sɔ̃su u bu nɔɔ kɑnɑ. Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ bɑ wuri nɔɔ kpɛ̃ɛ bɑ swĩ.
Yerɑ bɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, sɑ ko kɑ nun dɑwɑ wunɛn tɔmbun mi.
Mɑ Nɑomi u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bii kurɔminu, i wuro bɛɛn tɔmbun mi. Mbɑn dɑɑbɑ i ko kɑ mɑn dɑ. Domi nɑ ǹ mɑɑ bii tɔn durɔbu tie nukurɔ be bɑ koo ko bɛɛn durɔbu.
Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, i ɡɔsiro nɛn bii kurɔminu. Domi nɑ bukurɑ kɔ, nɑ ǹ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ wi u koo durɔ suɑ. Bɑɑ nɑ̀ n mɑɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔwɑ nɑ nɛɛ, kon durɔ wɑ wɔ̃ku te kpɑ n ɡurɑ suɑ n bii mɑ,
i ko i yɔ̃rɑ ù n kpɛ̃ɑ i sere nùn suɑ durɔ? Nɡe win sɔ̃nɑ i ko nɛɛ, i ǹ durɔ ɡoo suɑmɔ? Aɑwo, nɛn bii kurɔminu, yeni yɑ ǹ koorɔ. Bɛɛn sɔ̃nɑ nɑ nuki sɑnkire too. Domi Gusunɔ u mɑn win nɔmu sɛ̃re.
Yerɑ be kpuro bɑ mɑɑ wuri nɔɔ kpɛ̃ɛ bɑ swĩ. Mɑ Oripɑ u Nɑomi sɔ̃su u nùn nɔɔ kɑnɑ u doonɑ. Adɑmɑ Rutu kun nùn deri.
Yerɑ Nɑomi u nɛɛ, wee wunɛn beruse u wurɑ win tɔmbun mi, kpɑ bɑ n ben bũnu sɑ̃ɑmɔ sɑnnu. Wunɛn tii ɑ ɡɔsiro ɑ nùn swĩi.
Mɑ Rutu u nɛɛ, ɑ ku mɑn tilɑsi ko n kɑ nun deri. A de n kɑ nun dɑ. Domi mi ɑ dɔɔ miyɑ kon dɑ. Mi ɑ wɑ̃ɑ, miyɑ ko nɑ n wɑ̃ɑ. Kpɑ wunɛn tɔmbu bu ko nɛn tɔmbu. Kpɑ Gusunɔ wunɛn Yinni u ko nɛn Yinni.
Mi kɑɑ ɡbi, miyɑ kon ɡbi, kpɑ bu sun sike mi sɑnnu. Gɑ̃ɑnu nù n derɑ nɑ nun deri, mɑ n kun mɔ ɡɔɔ, Gusunɔ u mɑn kuo nɡe mɛ u kĩ.
Ye Nɑomi u wɑ mɑ Rutu u yɔ̃rɑwɑ u kɑ nùn dɑ, yerɑ u ǹ mɑɑ ɡɛɛ ɡeruɑ.
Mɑ be yiru ye kpuro bɑ dɑ Bɛtelehɛmuɔ sɑnnu. Ye bɑ turɑ mi, mɑ biti tɔmbu mwɑ bɑ mɔ̀, Nɑomiwɑ mini?
Mɑ u bu wisɑ u nɛɛ, i ku mɑɑ mɑn soku Nɑomi, i mɑn sokuo Mɑrɑ
. Domi Dɑm kpuroɡii u mɑn nuki sɑnkɑ.

Doo nɔɔrɑ nɑ kɑ yɑrɑ minin di, ɑdɑmɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u derɑ nɑ ɡɔsirɑmɑ nɔm dirɑ. Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ i mɑn sokumɔ Nɑomi. Domi wee Yinni Gusunɔ Dɑm kpuroɡii u mɑn tɑɑrɛ wɛ̃, mɑ u mɑn nuku sɑnkirɑnu kpɛ̃ɛ.
Nɡe mɛyɑ Nɑomi kɑ win biɡii kurɔ Rutu, Mɔɑbu, bɑ kɑ Mɔɑbun tem deri bɑ nɑ Bɛtelehɛmuɔ dĩɑ ni bɑ mɔ̀ ɔɔsun ɡɛ̃ɛrun tore sɔɔ.
Rutu u dĩɑnu kunɔnu mɔ̀
Boɑsin ɡberɔ

footnotes.text: Mɑrɑ - Yĩsi ten tubusiɑnɑ sosurɑ. Nɑomi, yĩsi ten tubusiɑnɑ, dobu.
